Each immutable epoch supplies4197 regular Git inputs, two compatibility overlays or one authority overlay, one Flow owner delta and one exact direct-test recursive-boundary assertion delta.14 fully guarded commands across three seeds retain original87 origins before/full147 origins after with actual references and48 complete original compiler/callback pairs unchanged. Corrected seven-group regression is RED6/GREEN7; ten suites including1034 Phase0 pass1180 groups; three separate authority groups recur GREEN after and original RED1 before.29 reason-specific evidence controls observe RED. Complete58-input book renders19 examples/three chapters with18 rejection controls.49 prior bridge input hashes verify before historical freeze.

Required OS/Perl/Python/prove/mdBook are read-only prerequisites; project data remains repository-local, Gitlinks/nonregular metadata exclude payloads and RGX/PGEN remain black boxes. Whole-family canonical acceptance .1.3.3 and membership/comments/replacement/global audits remain separate.
